question: Which entities are excluded as material causes of the pure path?
premises: The pure path requires a specific account of causation.
Māyā, the Lord, the individual self, and power are considered as candidates.
None of these serve as the material cause of the pure path.
inference: Therefore Māyā, the Lord, the individual self, and power are not the material cause of the pure path.
plain_english: Neither Māyā, nor the Lord, nor the individual self, nor power is the material cause of the pure path.
